title: Product pages begin returning server errors
prompt: Beginning at 09:00 UTC, product-detail pages return HTTP 500 for most requests while the storefront home page remains available. Identify the root cause and causal path.

evidence.content: catalog-service: SQLSTATE 28P01 authentication failed for user catalog_reader; 19 retries exhausted for GetProduct.

evidence.summary: Catalog database credential reached its expiry
evidence.content: Secret metadata for catalog-db-reader: issued 2026-07-02T09:00Z, expires 2026-08-01T09:00Z, rotation status overdue, mounted revision 183.

evidence.summary: Product request fails in the catalog dependency
evidence.content: Trace product-page/9af: storefront 5032 ms -> catalog GetProduct 5001 ms ERROR -> catalog-db connect ERROR authentication rejected.

evidence.summary: Catalog error rate jumps without resource saturation
evidence.content: catalog error rate rose to 96%; CPU remained 22%, memory 38%, and pod restarts zero.

evidence.summary: Database resources and other clients remain healthy
evidence.content: catalog database CPU 35%, storage latency 4 ms, and connections from admin and batch users succeed; only catalog_reader is rejected.

evidence.summary: Storefront maps catalog failures to HTTP 500
evidence.content: storefront: GetProduct dependency failed after timeout; rendering product-detail returned status=500.
